counter.message: SELINA: A 'favor,' he calls it — trying to buy the best quarterback in this building with a thirty-two-year-old and his own personal clipboard holder. Adorable. You want Josh Allen, Leon? Fine, everybody wants Josh Allen. Throw Rashee Rice in on top of Henry and Ward and NOW you're paying what he's worth. GARY: (I ran the numbers the second this landed — Henry-plus-Ward alone is a real step down from Allen's projection, so I've attached one more name before she even looked up from her phone. This is me doing my job, for once, before she tells me I didn't.)

message: SELINA: Leon thinks confidence is currency. It isn't — I set the price, and the price just went up. GARY: (countering with an added piece, per the file; declining outright gets logged if he balks, but my guess is his ego closes this anyway.)
